name: 澳大利亚 TFN 验证

map.澳大利亚 TFN 验证器。输入 8 或 9 位税号，按官方权重算法校验校验位，用: Australia TFN validator. Enter an 8- or 9-digit tax number; validate the check digit via the official weighted algorithm, for number-format checks in Australian tax and employer scenarios (does not verify authenticity).
map.TFN 校验：8 位按权重 [1,4,3,7,5,8,6,9,10] 求和 mo: TFN check: 8 digits weighted [1,4,3,7,5,8,6,9,10] sum mod 11 = 0
map.依据澳大利亚 ATO 官方算法校验 8 或 9 位税号(TFN)的校验位；用于税: Validates the check digit of 8- or 9-digit TFN per the Australian ATO official algorithm; for number-format checks in tax and employer scenarios (does not verify authenticity).
map.校验澳洲 TFN 的加权 mod 11 校验位: Validate the weighted mod-11 check digit of the Australian TFN
map.澳洲雇佣、报税前核对税号: Verify the tax number before Australian employment or filing
map.输入 123456782 会被判失败（加权和 255 不能被 11 整除）；换成: Entering 123456782 fails (weighted sum 255 not divisible by 11); switch to a number divisible by 11 to pass.
map.TFN 校验算法是什么？: What is the TFN check algorithm?
map.9 位（8 位前补 0）按权重 1、4、3、7、5、8、6、9、11 加权，总和: 9 digits (8-digit with leading zero) weighted 1,4,3,7,5,8,6,9,11; the sum must be divisible by 11.
map.为什么常见测试号校验失败？: Why do common test numbers fail validation?
map.部分流传的测试号并不满足官方校验，页面按真实算法判定；请以能被 11 整除的号码: Some circulated test numbers don't satisfy the official check; the page judges by the real algorithm; use a number divisible by 11.
map.校验通过代表税号有效吗？: Does passing mean the TFN is valid?
map.不代表。是否注册有效须在澳洲税务局（ATO）官方渠道确认。: No. Whether it's registered valid must be confirmed via the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) official channel.
